subject: english-literature
title: Hooks, Twists and Tie-Offs
welcome_lead: Great plots hook, twist, then satisfy. Learn the craft.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on hooks, twists and resolution craft.
final_note: You can now spot hooks, twists and tidy or open endings.

concepts.def: Hint of what will happen later.
Ending that ties off all threads.

walkthroughs.body_html: A hook can be a shock, a question or a vivid image. Strong hooks make readers turn the page.
A plot twist works best when subtle foreshadowing made it possible — readers feel surprised yet satisfied.
An open ending invites discussion; a closed ending resolves everything. Writers choose to match theme.
